Author: MTVirux
Name: Damage Terror
Punchline: Native ImGui damage meter overlay powered by IINACT
Description: A native damage meter that connects to IINACT via IPC or WebSocket and renders DPS/HPS bars entirely in ImGui. No browser overlay needed. Commands: /dt - toggle the damage meter window.
